column3: rationale
Accepted declined expired pending and budget comparisons match hand-derived total of 1300 minor units
No quote records yield zero quotes and no fabricated affordability conclusion
A quoted request cannot silently disappear from the response denominator
A request has one response snapshot per assessment
Responses must refer to a canonical quote
Response identity must join to a canonical request
Quote analysis scope must match the service-access ledger
Currency mismatch must block comparisons
Acceptance requires an event time
A booked request cannot have an unresolved quote decision
Decline reason must be explicit or NotStated
Pending state has no decision timestamp
Expiry must occur at or after the quote validity boundary
Individual budget cannot be stored without explicit consent
Stale quote evidence cannot support the aggregate
Malformed source digest shape blocks
Per-unit fee multiplied by quantity uses checked arithmetic
Additional mandatory fees use checked addition
Farmer price-decline reason cannot contradict disclosed ceiling covering the quote
Explicit total-for-scope fee basis must not be multiplied by quantity
Source references are provenance but are not authenticated by syntax
Exact budget amounts remain decimal strings for JSON consumers
